title: PlaybackState::pending_media_seek is an Option tuple with a bare ChatId and no account owner
trigger: Open a t.me/c/..?t=30 link, then switch account before the message loads, to an account that also shows the same chat id
effect: the seek can fire (or be dropped) for the other account's same-id chat; self-expires after 12 s
fix: hold it in the owning OnScreen/ChatUi as an enum MediaSeek::Waiting{chat: AccountChat, message, seconds, deadline}

title: FolderLoad::Merging is a bare in-flight stage; its answer is matched by purpose+folder id and the fetch is re-sent from upkeep
trigger: Edit a folder, change it elsewhere, press Save: start_folder_editor_merge sends fetch_chat_folder, drops the RequestId and enters Merging; settle_folder_editor_merge (run from maybe_prefill_folder_editor on every poll) matches with requests.has_purpose_for_folder(GetChatFolder, id) and re-sends fetch_chat_folder when no request and no error is left
effect: another window's/older GetChatFolder for the same folder counts as ours; a swept request is re-sent each poll; with no live session Merging has no way out except cancel
fix: Merging { request: RequestId } settled with fetch.waits_for/answered like Loading and Saving

title: DiskUi::screen_refused and start_refused are refusal-stage bools kept beside DiskStage and reset by hand
trigger: Disk falls below the open floor while Quill starts a client: connect_ui::refuse_screen_open sets screen_refused, background_accounts sets start_refused; apply_reading/reconnect_after_disk clear them from several places
effect: no bug today; the two flags must change together with DiskStage and are cleared from apply_reading, reconnect_after_disk and the DiskStep arms (not by DiskStage transitions)
fix: fold into DiskStage as a Refused{screen,starts} part of the single stage value

title: EarnUi::layer (EarnLayer::Open{back,restore}) mirrors Session users_state.open_info_panel == Earn(..) and must change with it
trigger: The Earn panel is closed by a path that sets open_info_panel directly (info-panel nav, account switch Farewell only drops it when earn_layer_open())
effect: no bug found: enter_earn_layer replaces a stale Open with a fresh one; but two owners (UI layer value and session open_info_panel) hold one fact
fix: derive Open from the session value and keep only back/restore/fade in a single EarnLayer owned by that value

title: links.deep_link_dialog is one Option<String> slot for a box that opens per window
trigger: Two typed links resolve to info text for two different windows before either box is closed
effect: the second text overwrites the first, so the first window's DeepLinkInfo box shows the second link's text; closing either clears the slot for both
fix: hold the text in the box stage owned by the window (WindowSlot) that opened it
